item.title: With Hollywood struggling in China, can the Odyssey draw a crowd?
item.summary: Christopher Nolan’s epic will be released on Friday across most of the country’s 800 Imax screens, at a time when western films have been struggling The Odyssey, Christopher Nolan’s summer blockbuster juggernaut, has overcome an onslaught of attacks from the world’s richest man and stared down criticism from a classicist who translated the poem , to become one of the year’s most celebrated and highest-grossing films. But this week, the film faces one of its biggest challenges yet. Continue reading...
